Some resource traders who ignored our warning and
continued operation in the Old City have been
taken prey by 1 Chi-You, still in the area.
Retaliation Squad requested for clean up.

Detected 1 Quadriga, a tank-type Aragami in the
grasslands. Dispatch requested. Not much is known
about the giant other than its weakness to 
Freeze. Beware of its smaller Aragami 
accompaniments.

Destroy 1 Borg Camlann before it crawls out of 
the subway remains. These Aragami look like giant
scorpions. Freeze and Spark may be effective.
Avoiding the Fallen Cocoon Maidens is suggested.

1 Vajra was encountered by the Research Unit's
force reconnaissance but has escaped to the Old
City. Blaze or Divine weapons are recommended.
Take caution of other smaller Aragami.

Defeat a Borg Camlann in the bay district. 
Destroying its hard armor and needle tail should 
be a priority. Freeze and Spark weapons will help 
get this done quickly.

A Quadriga has begun actively devouring in the
temple ruins. Freeze weapons are proven valid.
Parts of a Quadriga are weak to Impact—crushing
weapons are thought to have a slight advantage.

Eliminate 1 Chi-You sighted in the grasslands. 
It's a troublesome Aragami that swiftly flies on
the open grasslands. Destroy the wings with guns
and make sure to suppress it so that it won't fly 
around again.

Requesting defeat of a Kongou and Gboro-Gboro 
spotted in the plains. Spark seems to be effective 
against both, so bear this in mind when selecting 
your weaponry. You may be in for a long fight, so 
prepare accordingly.

Defeat the 2 Gboro-Gboros and 1 Fallen Ogretail 
in the abandoned factory. Spark is effective against
Gboro-Gboros, while the Fallen Ogretail is 
adapted to the cold. Blaze weapons will prove 
useful.

Research Unit has detected a swarm of Ogretails 
in the abandoned factory. Your target is 3 Ogretails 
and 2 Fallen Ogretails. All Ogretails are weak to
Sunder and piercing close-range attacks.

1 Quadriga confirmed in the bay district. Head to 
the landing point and defeat it. We have found 
that Quadriga have low resistance to Freeze and 
Divine attributes. Keep this in mind.

Defeat 2 Cocoon Maidens and 1 Zygote in the
grasslands. All are magmatic. Freeze is effective
for these fallen species. Beware of the Cocoon's
killzone. This is not a difficult mission.

Defeat two Fallen Ogretails in the grasslands. They
are polar phenotypes, so Blaze weapons are
advised. The terrain is flat and Zygotes are on
the lookout. Prepare for a chaotic battle.

Defeat a Borg Camlann that was detected in the 
temple ruins. Freeze and Spark weaponry is 
advised. The target is accompanied by Zygotes and 
Fallen Ogretails. Engaging multiple hostiles is 
dangerous and should be avoided where possible.
